description: This file defines a React component named `TabbedPane` along with a supporting subcomponent `TabbedPaneTab`. It implements a tabbed interface with optional toolbars and supports different modes ('default' and 'select') for tab navigation. It includes TypeScript interfaces and React functional components, as well as associated styling via CSS modules.

methods.name: TabbedPane
methods.description: React functional component for rendering a tabbed interface with optional left and right toolbars, supporting mode toggling between 'default' and 'select'.

methods.name: TabbedPaneTab
methods.description: React functional component that renders an individual tab within the TabbedPane, showing title, counters, and handling selection.
